title: Normalized exact tower augmentation and coherent counit evaluation
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites with sheaves of commutative rings $R,S$, and put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $\mathcal E=\mathcal A,\mathcal B$, use strict towers $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal E)$, with levelwise exactness [def-weil-inverse-system, lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian], and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and exact, and let $H:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$, $\widetilde H:D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A))\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal B))$ be its termwise derived functors with their canonical localization comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Write $\Delta,\Delta'$ for derived constant towers, $e_n,e'_n$ for derived evaluations, and $d_{m,n}:e_m\to e_n$, $d'_{m,n}:e'_m\to e'_n$ for the transformations induced by the unique index arrow, for $m\ge n$.

Let $j:\widetilde H\Delta\xrightarrow{\sim}\Delta'H$, $t_n:e'_n\widetilde H\xrightarrow{\sim}He_n$, $s_n:e_n\Delta\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$, and $s'_n:e'_n\Delta'\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ be the canonical exact-localization isomorphisms induced respectively by the ordinary constant/pullback, evaluation/pullback, and constant/evaluation identities. Fix the canonical adjunction $\Delta'\dashv L'$ where $L'=R\lim$ is computed by K-injective tower resolutions, which exist for complexes of strict towers of module sheaves on a small site [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], with unit $v'$ and counit $\varepsilon'$ [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections]. Let $\pi'_{n,N}:L'N\to e'_nN$ be its specified K-injective limit projections, using $s'_n$ to identify evaluation of a constant tower with its input.

The following simultaneous coherence identities hold for all derived $K,M$:
$$t_{n,\Delta K}\,e'_n(j_K^{-1})\,(s'_{n,HK})^{-1}=H(s_{n,K}^{-1}),\qquad t_{n,M}d'_{m,n,\widetilde HM}=H(d_{m,n,M})t_{m,M}.$$
For any morphism $i:\Delta K\to M$ in the derived strict tower category, put
$$a=\widetilde H(i)j_K^{-1},\quad b=L'(a)v'_{HK},\quad q_n=e_n(i)s_{n,K}^{-1},\quad p_n=t_{n,M}\pi'_{n,\widetilde HM}.$$
Then
$$\varepsilon'_{\widetilde HM}\Delta'(b)=a,\qquad t_{n,M}e'_n(a)(s'_{n,HK})^{-1}=H(q_n),\qquad p_nb=H(q_n),\qquad H(d_{m,n,M})p_m=p_n.$$
For $m\ge n\ge r$ one has
$$H(d_{n,r,M})H(d_{m,n,M})p_m=H(d_{m,r,M})p_m=p_r,$$
and $d_{n,n}=\mathrm{id}$ gives the identity-index formula. These are natural identities: for $f:K\to K'$ and $u:M\to M'$ with $ui=i'\Delta(f)$ one has $L'\widetilde H(u)b_i=b_{i'}H(f)$, together with the corresponding naturality squares for $q_n$ and $p_n$. No product preservation by $F$ or invertibility of $b$ is assumed.

Agent-written exact-localization coherence refinement; underlying derived adjunction: Stacks derived.tex, Tag 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors), with K-injective tower model sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok).

proof.text: Use right-to-left composition throughout. The ordinary constant functor is exact because its kernels and cokernels are constant levelwise; postcomposition by $F$ is exact levelwise, and evaluations are exact. Hence all the functors defining $j,t_n,s_n,s'_n$ act termwise on complexes and preserve quasi-isomorphisms by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Fix their factorization isomorphisms $a_G:D(G)Q\xrightarrow{\sim}QC(G)$. For a composite use the iterated factorization: for $G_2G_1$ the normalization of $D(G_2)D(G_1)Q$ is $a_{G_2,C(G_1)(-)}D(G_2)(a_{G_1})$. This specifies all the comparisons below without using a product comparison. Reuse the proved factorization API towerInterchange_fac and towerTransition_fac from the existing tower normalization module, and rct_eval_fac and rct_pull_fac from the existing constant-tower normalization module. Their proofs are shared in their original modules rather than copied.

source.place: Tag 015F, lemma-right-derived-exact-functor; levelwise kernels and cokernels

proof.text:
Apply clauses (2) and (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] to the source localization $Q_{\mathcal A}$. A comparison induced by an ordinary identity $U=V$ has component $\alpha_V^{-1}\alpha_U$ on $QK$, where $\alpha_U,\alpha_V$ are the iterated factorizations of Step 1 into the common termwise complex. In the composite
$$t_{n,\Delta K}\,e'_n(j_K^{-1})\,(s'_{n,HK})^{-1}$$
the successive ordinary operations are constant, $F$, and evaluation; either order gives exactly $C(F)K$. Substitute these factorization formulas. Naturality of each $a_G$ moves a whiskered comparison to the common termwise target; every intermediate $\alpha\alpha^{-1}$ cancels. The remaining comparison is the one induced by the identity from $F$ to $F e_n\Delta$, namely $H(s_{n,K}^{-1})$. Thus the first coherence identity holds on every $Q_{\mathcal A}K$ and hence everywhere by clause (3). The same calculation for $e_n\Delta$ and the ordinary identity transitions of a constant tower gives
$$d_{m,n,\Delta K}s_{m,K}^{-1}=s_{n,K}^{-1},\qquad d'_{m,n,\Delta'X}(s'_{m,X})^{-1}=(s'_{n,X})^{-1}.$$
Here equality of transformations is detected by localization, not by testing evaluations of arbitrary derived towers.

source.place: Tag 04VG, lemma-properties-left-localization; natural-transformation version in Localization.Predicate, liftNatTrans_app and natTrans_ext; explicit agent calculation

proof.text:
For a strict tower complex $T$ and its actual index arrow $T_m\to T_n$, ordinary evaluation/postcomposition gives the equality $F(T_m\to T_n)=(F^{\rm Tow}T)_m\to(F^{\rm Tow}T)_n$, in every degree. Apply localization clause (2) to this natural transformation, with the normalization of Step 1. Its component formula conjugates both sides by the same source and target factorizations, giving
$$t_{n,M}d'_{m,n,\widetilde HM}=H(d_{m,n,M})t_{m,M}$$
for $M=QT$. Clause (3) gives the identity on all $M$. The ordinary identity law for index arrows similarly descends to $d_{n,n}=1$, using liftNatTrans_id. The composite-index conclusion below follows directly from projection compatibility, without needing a separate composition law for derived transitions. All indices here are arbitrary $m\ge n\ge r\ge1$, not just consecutive indices.

source.place: Tag 04VG, lemma-properties-left-localization; natural-transformation descent and strict index functor law

proof.text:
Set $X=HK$ and $N=\widetilde HM$. The adjunction and counit normalization are those of [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections]. By naturality of $\varepsilon'$ at $a:\Delta'X\to N$, and the left triangle identity of this adjunction,
$$\varepsilon'_N\Delta'(b)=\varepsilon'_N\Delta'L'(a)\Delta'(v'_X)=a\varepsilon'_{\Delta'X}\Delta'(v'_X)=a.$$
Thus this is the actual specified counit, rather than a replacement map having the same level maps.

source.place: Tag 09T5, lemma-derived-adjoint-functors; adjunction naturality and defining left triangle identity

proof.text:
Naturality of $t_n$ at $i$ and Step 2 give
$$t_{n,M}e'_n(a)(s'_{n,HK})^{-1}=H(e_n i)t_{n,\Delta K}e'_n(j_K^{-1})(s'_{n,HK})^{-1}=H(e_n i)H(s_{n,K}^{-1})=H(q_n).$$
This uses naturality for the given derived arrow $i$; it does not choose a strict representative for that arrow.

source.place: Agent calculation using naturality of the specified localization comparison and Step 2

proof.text:
The counit projection formula of [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections], with its constant/evaluation identification written explicitly, is
$$\pi'_{n,N}=e'_n(\varepsilon'_N)(s'_{n,L'N})^{-1}.$$
Naturality of $s'_n$ at $b:X\to L'N$ therefore gives
$$\pi'_{n,N}b=e'_n(\varepsilon'_N)e'_n(\Delta'b)(s'_{n,X})^{-1}=e'_n(a)(s'_{n,X})^{-1}.$$
The last equality is Step 4. Multiply by $t_{n,M}$ and use Step 5 to obtain $p_nb=H(q_n)$.

source.place: Tag 09T5 via the cited counit-projection statement; Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok, for its specified tower model

proof.text:
Naturality of the transition transformation $d'_{m,n}$ at $\varepsilon'_N$ and the constant-tower identity of Step 2 imply
$$d'_{m,n,N}\pi'_{m,N}=d'_{m,n,N}e'_m(\varepsilon'_N)(s'_{m,L'N})^{-1}=e'_n(\varepsilon'_N)d'_{m,n,\Delta'L'N}(s'_{m,L'N})^{-1}=\pi'_{n,N}.$$
Using Step 3 now yields
$$H(d_{m,n,M})p_m=t_{n,M}d'_{m,n,N}\pi'_{m,N}=t_{n,M}\pi'_{n,N}=p_n.$$
No faithfulness of the family of evaluations is used: the first equality is naturality of transformations already defined on the derived tower category.

source.place: Tag 09T5 via counit projection normalization; transition naturality and Steps 2–3

proof.text: For $m\ge n\ge r$, apply Step 7 first to $(m,n)$ and then to $(n,r)$ to obtain $H(d_{n,r,M})H(d_{m,n,M})p_m=p_r$. Apply Step 7 directly to $(m,r)$ to identify $H(d_{m,r,M})p_m=p_r$. These give both composite-index equalities. For the identity-index formula, Step 3 gives $d_{n,n}=1$; apply $H(1)=1$ and the categorical identity law.

source.place: Agent calculation from Step 7, plus the localized identity index law of Step 3

proof.text:
Write $N'=\widetilde HM'$ and assume $ui=i'\Delta f$. Naturality of $j$ gives $\widetilde H(u)a_i=a_{i'}\Delta'H(f)$, by substituting $a_i=\widetilde H(i)j_K^{-1}$. Naturality of $v'$ consequently gives
$$L'\widetilde H(u)b_i=L'(a_{i'})L'\Delta'H(f)v'_{HK}=L'(a_{i'})v'_{HK'}H(f)=b_{i'}H(f).$$
Naturality of $s_n$ and $ui=i'\Delta f$ gives $e_n(u)q_{n,i}=q_{n,i'}f$. Finally the naturality in $N$ of the specified projections in [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections], followed by naturality of $t_n$, gives
$$H(e_nu)p_{n,M}=t_{n,M'}e'_n\widetilde H(u)\pi'_{n,N}=t_{n,M'}\pi'_{n,N'}L'\widetilde H(u)=p_{n,M'}L'\widetilde H(u).$$
These are precisely the requested naturality squares. None of Steps 1–9 requires preservation of infinite products or invertibility of $b$.
